title: Modern AI Resume Builder: Convert Code, Commits & Projects into an ATS-Ready PDF
description: How modern AI resume builders analyze your GitHub repositories and generate high-scoring, single-page tech resumes.
body:
Traditional resume writing is time-consuming and prone to formatting errors. InternFlow's AI Resume Builder revolutionizes the process by analyzing your GitHub commit history, extracting the frameworks and libraries you actually used, and generating quantifiable impact statements in standard LaTeX formatting.

## 1. Key Features of the InternFlow Resume Builder

- Direct GitHub Integration: Automatically pull repository titles, descriptions, and commit metadata.
- XYZ Bullet Formatting: Every bullet point is formulated to show action, metric, and engineering method.
- Instant ATS Score Feedback: Receive a match score against any target job posting before you submit.
- Clean 1-Page LaTeX PDF: Zero formatting corruption across different operating systems and PDF readers.

faq.q: Can I edit the generated resume bullets manually?
faq.a: Yes! You have full control to edit, refine, or reorder any bullet point in the interactive web editor before downloading your PDF.
